# moltbot-mcp

MCP server for Moltbot (ClawdBot) Gateway: status, health, send, agent, channels. FastMCP 3.4+.

**Repo:** github.com/sandraschi/moltbot-mcp (private)

## Tools

- **moltbot_ops** — Portmanteau: status, health, send, agent, channels.
- **help** — Multilevel help (basic/intermediate/advanced/expert).
- **moltbot_shutdown** — Gracefully shut down the server (requires confirm=True).
- **show_moltbot_status_card** — Prefab UI card showing Gateway connection status.

## Config

Env prefix `MOLTBOT_MCP_`:

| Var | Default | Description |
|-----|---------|-------------|
| `GATEWAY_HOST` | 127.0.0.1 | Moltbot Gateway host |
| `GATEWAY_PORT` | 18789 | Gateway port |
| `GATEWAY_TOKEN` | - | Optional auth token |
| `USE_WS` | true | Use WebSocket |

## API Endpoints (FastAPI, port 10731)

- `GET /api/v1/health` — Liveness probe
- `GET /api/v1/status` — Server status with tool count
- `GET /api/capabilities` — Capability discovery with tool list
- `GET /api/skills` — List available skills
- `GET /api/skills/{name}` — Get skill content
- `GET /api/v1/diagnostics` — Full diagnostics with tool list
- `GET /api/gateway` — Gateway WebSocket probe
- `GET /api/logs` — In-memory log ring buffer

## Ports

- Frontend (Vite): 10730
- Backend (FastAPI): 10731

## Resources

- `skill://moltbot-ops` — Gateway operations skill content
- `config://env` — Current environment configuration

## Prompts

- `gateway_help(topic)` — Guidance for Gateway operations

## Installation

```powershell
git clone https://github.com/sandraschi/moltbot-mcp.git
cd moltbot-mcp
uv sync --all-extras
# Start backend API: uv run --extra web python webapp/server.py
# Start frontend: cd webapp && npm install && npm run dev
```

## Claude Desktop Config

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "moltbot-mcp": {
      "command": "uv",
      "args": ["--directory", "D:/Dev/repos/moltbot-mcp", "run", "moltbot-mcp"]
    }
  }
}
```
